findings.text: the figure tier asks _unreadable_figure_review_records only when _newest_figure_review returns None, so a run carrying one parseable figure record plus one unparsable figure-named file is landed by the lander while promotion's _require_no_undisposed_blocking_figure_finding refuses it on the unreadable file (it checks unreadable first, unconditionally) — the misattributed land failure this section removes, in a narrowed case. The plan prescribes this order, so it is recorded rather than repaired here.

edited outside the node's declared write paths (review_tier -> awaiting_tier, one assertion); forced by the key rename the section requires, disclosed in the manifest's outside_scope, and green in both population arms.
